description: Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts: in the landabilityScore function, give documentation_drift gaps a fair competing score so they are not structurally outranked by surgical source gaps. Currently zero documentation_drift gaps appear across 429 picker decisions over 24 hours: a documentation_drift gap typically lacks an edit_site (so misses the +0.3 concrete-change-site boost) and is not in SURGICAL_CATEGORIES (so misses the +0.15 boost), leaving it near the 0.5 base while surgical source gaps reach ~0.9 and always win the ranking. Add a modest landability boost for gaps whose category is "documentation_drift" (for example s += 0.2) so the documentation backlog can be worked. Keep the final score clamped to [0,1].
